provenance.source: Taxation Act, 2007 (Ontario); CRA T4127 Chapter 8 (Ontario); Ontario indexation factor 1.9% for 2026
provenance.notes: Brackets, BPA and surtax thresholds are the 2025 amounts indexed at 1.9% and rounded to the dollar. The 150.000 and 220.000 thresholds are not indexed. NOT verified against T4127 - this file is the single place to correct it.

surtax.note: A surtax on provincial TAX PAYABLE after non-refundable credits, not on income. Both layers apply above the second threshold.

healthPremium.note: The Ontario Health Premium is payable on taxable income and is added to Ontario tax. Not indexed.

medical.note: The Ontario threshold differs slightly from the federal one. The federal figure is used as an approximation pending verification.

omissions: The Ontario LIFT low-income tax credit is not modelled, so low incomes are overstated.
The Ontario Trillium Benefit and other refundable credits are not modelled - they are benefits, not part of tax payable.
Ontario has no equivalent of the federal Canada Employment Amount.
